rationale: All 8 runs are feasible with wide margins (0 DRC, hold +0.08-0.11 ns, at most 101 slew/cap pins vs bar 953), so only T_eff matters. T_eff tracks the target: loose targets give 9.45-10.15 ns, tight ones (pf 0.48-0.52) 8.57-9.55. The two best (des 8.574, md5 8.807) share cap213 RC, post-GRT timing repair, no routability-driven placement, util 27-30, and still ended ~0.55 ns positive, while stock/orfs runs at similar targets did worse. So: target the floor (pf 0.45 = 8.49 ns, close to des's T_eff, so a pass should reproduce), keep des's DELAY 4 synthesis, and raise repair margins slightly to push below the period floor. Other knobs stay free.
